unresolved.name: DY Patil University School of Medicine, Pune
unresolved.why: Cannot be safely resolved. 'School of Medicine' is D Y Patil deemed-university branding used by TWO different campuses: the Nerul/Navi Mumbai school (https://dypatil.edu/schools/school-of-medicine) and a new Ambi/Maval, Pune school (https://dypatil.edu/schools/school-of-medicine-ambi, est. 2024, ~50 MBBS seats) — while Dr. D. Y. Patil Vidyapeeth's Pune college is branded 'Dr. D. Y. Patil Medical College, Pimpri'. Merging it into the Pimpri cluster or into the Navi Mumbai cluster could both be wrong, and it is absent from the 2023 NMC registry, so it is left as its own record. It already has state/city/type (Maharashtra/Pune/Deemed) in our base, so it still imports; no enrichment applied.
